# PHP Ledger

> PHP Ledger is open-source, self-hosted double-entry accounting software with a simple cash point of sale for small businesses, built on PHP 8.2+ and MySQL 8.4 and currently in development preview.

Current preview: 0.3.0-preview. PHP 8.2+ (8.3 recommended), MySQL 8.4 (InnoDB), HTTPS, terminal access.

New project-owned code: AGPL-3.0-or-later; commercial licensing available. Pre-adoption 0.1.0 through 0.1.5 previews retain MIT; dependencies and archived code keep their own terms.

## Implemented scope

- Company setup in ten functional currencies, one immutable functional currency per book; account management and audit history.
- Receipt, expense and general-journal drafts, balanced posting, linked dated reversals and correction mechanics preserving document identity.
- Account ledgers, trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, core CSV exports, bank CSV reconciliation, period controls and reviewed opening-cutover workflow.
- Cash POS with a synthetic catalogue and printable receipt; four synthetic business packs and reporting walkthroughs.
- Scoped, revocable read API and MCP connections, with the published client compatibility matrix defining tested clients.
- Developer foundations: exact multi-currency line snapshots, manual rates, party/contact schema, authoritative open items, realised FX settlement mechanics and an unconfigured retryable event outbox.

## Outside the current workflows

- Customer/vendor invoice and bill documents, operator settlement workflows, credit notes and ageing screens.
- Inventory, cost of sales, tax engines, statutory filing and professionally accepted reporting packages.
- Foreign-currency entry screens, rate providers, period-end revaluation and group consolidation.
- Vetting enforcement, vendor bank change control and outbound connectors.
- Financial write API/MCP, card processing, offline use, document scanning and detailed historical imports.
